Definition: Salma, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: The name is Salma, the name of two Israelites. You find the name in 1 Chronicles 2:11, "And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz", and again in 1 Chronicles 2:51 and 1 Chronicles 2:54.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Salma counts, because God wrote the name down and I believe he meant it. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
RelatedPeople: Salma, Son of Nahshon; Salma, Son of Caleb
